svg.text: Servo Driver with ESP32 sends DATA only · battery powers the servos through the power tee · 10× ST3215 in two chains of 5
no servo current through the board
middle joint — board, battery & tee on a deck here
stock 15 cm servo leads between servos (leave ~30 mm slack at each joint)
stock 15 cm servo leads between servos (leave ~30 mm slack at each joint)
1. Battery → fuse → loop key → tee: meter 12.x V on both headers
2. Set buck to 7.5 V, then plug it into the board
3. Port 1 lead to tee (red wire cut), 1 servo per side
5. During gait: ID1 and ID10 must read ≥ 11 V
• Each chain carries only 5 servos (≈1.5–2.5 A walking)
• Voltage drop to the last servo ≈ 0.3–0.5 V
• Board carries only DATA, so its current limit doesn't matter
• Each 5 A fuse protects one chain if a servo jams
• Firmware: torque limit ~70 %, stop if a chain > 3 A
